units.source_text: 这位姑娘他以前也见过几次，每次总是给他留下感人的印象，可当她这样无所事事地坐在他跟前时，他反而感到特别不自在。

en.t: He had seen this girl several times before, and each time she had left him with a moving impression; but when she sat before him like this with nothing to do, he instead felt especially uneasy.

units.source_text: 她那副过分认真的样子，看起来仿佛总是处在一种异常事态之中。

en.t: Her excessively serious manner made it seem as though she were always caught in some extraordinary situation.
